description: This file defines two custom attributes, CollectionAgeLimitAttribute and KeepAliveAttribute, used for configuring grain collection and deactivation policies in Orleans. It includes properties and methods to specify inactivity periods and whether grains should be kept alive indefinitely.

classes.name: CollectionAgeLimitAttribute
classes.description: An attribute that specifies the inactivity period before a grain is eligible for collection and deactivation in Orleans.

classes.name: KeepAliveAttribute
classes.description: An attribute that indicates that a grain should never be collected by the idle activation collector, effectively keeping it alive indefinitely.

methods.name: CollectionAgeLimitAttribute()
methods.description: Default constructor for setting up the attribute.

methods.name: CollectionAgeLimitAttribute(string inactivityPeriod)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the inactivity period using a string parsed into a TimeSpan.

methods.name: Populate(IServiceProvider services, Type grainClass, GrainType grainType, Dictionary<string, string> properties)
methods.description: Populates the properties dictionary with the appropriate idle deactivation period based on the attribute settings.

methods.name: CalculateValue()
methods.description: Calculates the TimeSpan value representing the inactivity period based on Days, Hours, Minutes, and AlwaysActive flag.

methods.name: Populate(IServiceProvider services, Type grainClass, GrainType grainType, Dictionary<string, string> properties) (KeepAliveAttribute)
methods.description: Sets the idle deactivation period to indefinite, ensuring the grain is never collected.
